h: Woman says friends were killed in Edo even after N25 million ransom was paid for each of them
p: A woman has reportedly cried out online over the deaths of friends in Edo State, saying a ransom of N25 million was paid for each of them before they were killed. The claim has not been independently confirmed. It has renewed debate about kidnapping and insecurity in the state.
more: Nigerians online are calling on security agencies to act.
The police have not yet responded to the claim.
